title: Work Journal: Granola meetings arrive again after Granola renamed its listing tool, and a missing Granola tool shows a warning
seam: The Work Journal candidate run: src-tauri/src/core/work_journal_run.rs, with one optional field carried through src-tauri/src/commands/work_journal.rs, src/stores/useWorkJournalCandidateRunStore.ts and the notice line of src/components/workjournal/SuggestionsBox.tsx
story: Work Journal suggestions include Granola meetings again; they had stopped after Granola renamed the tool Maestro used to list a day's meetings. Each run now checks that Granola still has the two tools Maestro needs. If one is missing while Granola is connected, the suggestions box shows a plain 'Maestro needs an update' line, and git, GitHub, Claude and terminal suggestions still arrive.

checks.criterion: A day with Granola meetings gives at least one suggestion with the Granola source
checks.steps: Connect Granola in Claude Code and answer Yes to the Granola question in the suggestions box. Hold a test meeting today, for example 'Demo sync', and keep today's journal page free of it. Click 'run now'.
checks.expected: A suggestion for that meeting tagged Granola, and no 'Maestro needs an update' line.

checks.criterion: The warning line shows only when a run reported a missing Granola tool
checks.steps: With Granola working normally, click 'run now'. Read the notice lines under the suggestions header.
checks.expected: No line 'Granola is connected, but Maestro could not read your meetings. Maestro needs an update.' The case where it does show only happens if Granola drops a tool, so the component test covers it.
